summary: Iteration 10 — Expanded Ambajogai directory (478 places incl. 38 landmarks), landmarks-first ordering, service-area 30 km enforcement. BACKEND: 117/117 pytest pass (18 maps/places/service-area + 99 regression). Verified GET /api/maps/config → local_places_count=478, google_enabled=false, radius=30, center={Ambajogai,18.73312,76.38616}. GET /api/places/search?q=empty returns landmarks first (first item Jogai Hall type='landmark'), each item has name, name_local, district, lat, lng, distance_from_ambajogai_km (all ≤30), type, sources list, id. GET /api/places/search?q=योг returns Yogeshwari Temple (Marathi). Landmarks list contains 'Ambajogai Bus Station' and 'Yogeshwari Temple'. POST /api/rides with pickup=(12.9758,77.6068) → 400 'Pickup is outside the ZipRides service area (30 km around Ambajogai)'; drop outside → 400; both inside → 200 searching. Destination modal header 'Pickup points & villages near Ambajogai' visible; 112 dest items; first 8 are landmarks (Jogai Hall, Yogeshwari Temple, Ambajogai Bus Station, Rural Hospital, Vimalnath Jain Temple, Shivleni Caves, Jain Caves, Choubhara Ganesh Temple). Typing 'योग' returns only 'Yogeshwari Temple'. Typing 'more' returns Morewadi first then Moregaon. Selecting Morewadi → route-meta '2.73 km · ~7 min (approx.)', ZipBike ₹104.6, ZipDelivery ₹101.87, confirm-ride-btn enabled (aria-disabled=None), service-area-alert hidden (expected). Service-area UI pathway verified in code at /app/frontend/app/customer/index.tsx:127-130,198-205,375 (confirm disabled when outsideArea.length>0). No Bengaluru favorites exist on this preview user so the alert couldn't be triggered via tap, but logic + backend 400 both verified. Updated 4 regression test files to Ambajogai coords (Bengaluru coords now blocked by service-area). MOCKED: Google APIs disabled (no key) → fallback estimate active and tests exercise 503/null paths.
